slides.title: Four findings from the cancellation survey
items: Too much coffee arriving was the top reason, ahead of price.
One in four people who cancelled did not know they could pause.
Gift recipients rarely convert without a prompt in the last week.
People who rate their first bag stay twice as long.

slides.title: The demand forecast is a short scheduled query
slides.caption: forecast.sql
slides.code:
SELECT origin,
       date_trunc('week', ship_date) AS week,
       sum(bags)                     AS bags,
       avg(sum(bags)) OVER (
         PARTITION BY origin
         ORDER BY date_trunc('week', ship_date)
         ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       )                             AS four_week_avg
FROM   shipments
GROUP  BY 1, 2
ORDER  BY 1, 2;
